raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Postpartum Return — Home, Mat Only"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe postpartum return to activity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Weeks 1-4: Gentle return (OB cleared for light activity)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Walking + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilts 2x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Walking + Glute activation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side_lying_leg_lift 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Mobility and Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          wall_push_hands 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_row_with_towel 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          thoracic_rotation (seated) 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 22m "Walking + Mobility Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilts 2x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 22m "Glute Activation + Balance":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          heel_slides 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_march (slow) 2x20..30s rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
      DAY Friday training 22m "Posture & Upper Body":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          wall_push_hands 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_row_with_towel 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_pulls (seated) 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walking + Core-safe activation":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilts 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          heel_slides 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridges 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Lower body & Balance":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          split_stance_shrugs 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          side_lying_leg_lift 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_single_leg_balance 3x20..30s rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Upper body & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_from_wall 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          towel_row 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          thoracic_rotation (seated) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walking + Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilts 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Functional Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          mini_squat_to_chair 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side_lying_leg_lift 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_march 3x30..40s rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Upper & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_from_wall 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          towel_row 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_pulls (seated) 3x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Weeks 5-8: Build stamina and foundational strength (still no heavy lifting or abdominal loading)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Brisk Walk + Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 18m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          mini_squat_to_chair 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          heel_slides 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Balance & Upper":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          standing_row_with_towel 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          incline_push_from_wall 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility & Core-safe":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilts 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog (modified, slow) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Brisk Walk + Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges_single_leg_progression 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          mini_squat_to_chair 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing_march 3x40..60s rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Upper stability":
        warmup:
          walking 18m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          incline_push_from_wall 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_pulls (standing) 3x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 32m "Core-safe control":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          heel_slides 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog (modified) 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank_knee_support 3x10..15s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Endurance walk + Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 22m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges 3x20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_step_over_small_obstacle (step-over) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          standing_single_leg_balance 3x30..40s rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 3x18 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          incline_push_from_wall 3x18 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          thoracic_rotation 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Functional movement":
        warmup:
          walking 18m
        main straight_sets:
          mini_lunges_to_support 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic_tilts 3x20 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Progressive Walk + Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 22m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridges_single_leg_progression 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          mini_squat_to_chair 3x18 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 3x18 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper Endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 3x20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          incline_push_from_wall 3x20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_pulls 3x15 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core-safe control & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          heel_slides 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank_knee_support 3x15..20s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Weeks 9-12: Reintroduce higher effort, prepare for full return at 12 weeks" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Long walk + Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 25m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_like_squat_with_bodyweight_focus 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridges_single_leg_progression 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_single_leg_balance 3x40..60s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper strength progression":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_from_knee_or_incline 4x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction_holds 3x15..20s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core reconditioning (no traditional crunches)":
        warmup:
          walking 18m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank_knee_support 4x20..30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug_modified 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Endurance + Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 28m
        main straight_sets:
          mini_lunges_to_support 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridges 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 4x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          walking 22m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_from_knee_or_incline 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_pulls 4x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 42m "Dynamic control":
        warmup:
          walking 18m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog_progression 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug_modified 4x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank_knee_support 4x25..35s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 30m
        main straight_sets:
          mini_squat_to_chair 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridges_single_leg_progression 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_single_leg_balance 4x45..60s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 25m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 4x18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_from_knee_or_incline 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          thoracic_rotation 4x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core readiness":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug_modified 4x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank_knee_support 4x30..45s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Preparation for full return":
        warmup:
          walking 30m
        main straight_sets:
          mini_squat_to_chair 4x18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridges 4x20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_hip_abductions 4x20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper strength readiness":
        warmup:
          walking 25m
        main straight_sets:
          towel_row 4x20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_from_knee_or_incline 4x18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction_holds 4x20..30s rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Final core & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog_progression 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug_modified 4x18 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank_knee_support 4x40..60s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knees_to_chest 5m

all_errors.message: Unknown exercise reference 'diaphragmatic_breathing'. Did you mean: dip?
Unknown exercise reference 'standing_hip_abductions'. Did you mean: standing_calf_raise, standing_forward_fold, dip?
Unknown exercise reference 'glute_bridges'. Did you mean: glute_bridge, leg_raise?
Unknown exercise reference 'side_lying_leg_lift'. Did you mean: side_plank, sumo_deadlift?
Unknown exercise reference 'wall_push_hands'. Did you mean: wall_ball?
Unknown exercise reference 'standing_row_with_towel'. Did you mean: standing_forward_fold, standing_calf_raise?
